find-the-journey-recipe.title: Find how to give an agent a user journey
find-the-journey-recipe.start: Run bun install and bun run site. Open the locally built For coding agents guide.

steps.action: Find the instructions for reviewing a user journey.
steps.expect: The guide gives the discovery and replay commands and links to a worked example.
The journey recipe opens at its heading and shows the example meeting, actions, expectations and replay command.
